digest: WHATWG DOM Standard directly specifies propagating the first already-aborted input’s reason to the result signal and returning it immediately.
verdictDigest: The normative algorithm exactly supports reason propagation and early return; MDN independently confirms that the first already-aborted input determines the returned signal’s reason.

evidence.quote: For each signal of signals: if signal is aborted, then set resultSignal’s abort reason to signal’s abort reason and return resultSignal.
evidence.relevance: Normative dependent abort signal creation algorithm directly matches the claim.

evidence.quote: The returned AbortSignal's reason will be already set to the reason of the first abort signal that was already aborted.
evidence.relevance: Authoritative reference confirms first-already-aborted input reason selection.

caveats: This claim covers reason propagation and early return; listener cleanup and garbage-collection behavior are separate considerations.
